item.title: [updated] RackWare - Disaster Recovery Subscription ( Annual ) (rackware-rmm-draas-per-unit) has changed the description of the plan named rackware-dr-plan-per-unit
item.description:
*before*: DR Software License, this includes standard 8*5 support from RackWare support team. Configuration and Setting up a DR site will be self managed by end user. This does not include Profressional Service level support. Pricing - $192 USD Per VM, Per Year, *after*: - This pricing plan includes:
-- RackWare Disaster Recovery (DR) Software Subscription License. -- Standard 8x5 technical support.
- Professional Services & Deployment:
-- Professional Services for the initial deployment and configuration of RackWare DR software are not included in this subscription. -- DR deployment and configuration services can be purchased separately through the RackWare Professional Services tile in the IBM Cloud Catalog. -- Customers who do not purchase Professional Services are responsible for the installation, deployment, configuration of their RackWare DR environment. -- Customers are responsible for provisioning and configuring their DR landing zone, including the required infrastructure and resources at the target recovery site. -- This is a self-managed DR subscription and does not include RackWare-managed DR operations, annual DR drills, or recovery testing services.
- Pricing: $192 USD per VM, per year.

item.title: [updated] RackWare - Disaster Recovery Subscription ( Annual ) (rackware-rmm-draas-per-unit) has changed the description of the plan named rackware-draas-plan-per-unit
item.description:
*before*: A fixed-price service bundling RackWare software, and expert-guided support. Support includes proactive guidance, configuration assistance, and expert-led troubleshooting to ensure successful execution within the defined scope. Pricing - $495 USD Per VM, Per Year, *after*: - This pricing plan includes:
-- RackWare Disaster Recovery as a Service (DRaaS) Software Subscription License. -- Ongoing DR operations and management provided by RackWare. -- One annual DR drill and test per VM. -- Standard 8x5 technical support.
- Professional Services & Deployment:
-- Professional Services for the initial deployment and configuration of RackWare DR software are not included in this subscription. -- DR deployment and configuration services can be purchased separately through the RackWare Professional Services tile in the IBM Cloud Catalog. -- Customers who do not purchase Professional Services are responsible for the initial installation, deployment, and configuration of the RackWare DR software. Once deployed, RackWare will manage ongoing DR operations as part of the DRaaS subscription. -- Customers are responsible for provisioning and configuring their DR landing zone, including the required infrastructure and resources at the target recovery site.
- Pricing: $495 USD per VM, per year.
